fusions.name: Run Down at Reach
fusions.desc: Lashes an enemy at or below 25% health up to 7 tiles away and deals 26 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range.

fusions.name: Marking Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks the first enemy in reach for 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave it [Exposed] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Lengthening Line
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 30% further.

fusions.name: Scent of the Kill
fusions.desc: Against a target at low health, your damage rises by 12%.
